description: Default capabilities for the EasyGit main window. `opener:allow-open-path` must carry a path scope: the permission pre-configures none, and the opener plugin denies every path while the allow list is empty (`Error::ForbiddenPath`), so the 打开文件夹 entry fails silently without it. `**` matches any user-chosen absolute path, which is what a repo folder and the log folder are.
